text:
Alex: FYI I started qBringUp for qx6b-int4 and the sampled prompt cohorts look off vs prod sampling. small repro below. :eyes:
Maria: ugh. which cohort? can you paste a couple example prompt ids and the sampling query?
Alex: sample ids: [p_9a3f, p_92bb, p_1e4c] - the sampler seems to over-index short Q&A prompts. query we used:
```sql
select id, len(tokens) as L from promptset where cohort='onboard-qx6b' order by rand() limit 500
```
Jordan: that RAND() -> ORDER BY is fine for quick smoke, but our reservoir sampler has a bug for long/short weighting after dedupe. seen similar in 2024-07. run fingerprint diff: `python tools/fingerprint_diff.py --left prod-cohort.json --right onboard-sample.json --top 50`
Liam: golden set contains 12 of those sample ids (p_9a3f etc). If dedupe removed near-duplicates they might still be in golden and skew metrics. we should lock golden updates until we reconcile. :no_entry_sign:
Sam: labeler capacity this week is low (half team OOO). I can spin a small micro-campaign (50 items) and prioritize the disputed ids, ETA 48h if we get the list. :calendar:
CurieBot: [alert] canary-eval finished: qx6b-int4 canary -> baseline delta: +0.3 perplexity, -3.8% F1 on longform-holdout. see /evals/4822167890/canary_report.json
Maria: -3.8% F1 is non-trivial. need to confirm whether it's model quantization or sample mismatch. run targeted eval with the golden subset:
```
./run_eval.sh --model qx6b-int4 --prompts holdout/golden_subset.json --metrics accuracy,f1,rouge-l --out /tmp/qx6b-golden.json
```
Alex: ran a quick spot-check. examples where qx6b-int4 regresses are long-context multi-turn instructions that got truncated in preprocessing. snippet from a failing prompt:
"""
System: You are a tutor.
User: Here's a 6-paragraph prompt with step-by-step context...
"""
Jordan: that sounds like an ingest/tokenization mismatch. maybe a new tokenizer mapping on the onboard pipeline. check tokenizer hash: `git rev-parse HEAD:tokenizers/v2` vs prod.
Liam: I pulled golden ids and created a temporary lock file: `/golden/locks/onboard-qx6b.lock` - don't update golden until we finish the rerun. Also collecting the dedupe diff report.
Sam: I'll open a label campaign with labelflow: campaign=qx6b-onboard-micro, items=50, priority=high. tagging @labelers for overtime. will post campaign id when ready.
Maria: once label campaign done, can someone re-run canary with only the reconciled golden subset? if regression disappears, it's sampling/ingest; if still present, model/quant issue. :mag_right:
Alex: agreed. fallback plan: route 100% canary traffic to qx6b-int8 (previous bin) for prod routes until we sign off. Jordan, can you prepare the rollback runbook?
Jordan: on it. runbook draft posted: `/docs/runbooks/qbringup-rollback.md` - includes traffic switch commands and monitoring hooks. will add the fingerprint diff output once available. :shipit:
CurieBot: [note] scheduled action: automated rerun of dedupe diff at +2h.
Maria: thanks team. next check-in in 2h after dedupe diff completes.
Alex: perfect, keeping this thread as source-of-truth. :zap:
